testedSource.basis: Canonical LF for text; exact binary assets. Identity is not semantic parity.

tests.skipExplanation: Offscreen WebView case has a passing Windows native_transcript_tabs_real counterpart.

coveredChanges: Custom HTTP models support exact-provider add/edit/move/rename/delete, context metadata, text/image and tool capabilities, encrypted private options/headers and version2 persistence when required.
A bounded typed translator maps supported custom options for OpenAI Chat, Responses, Anthropic and Google while protecting native history, tools, system and streaming construction.
Same-ID custom changes or deletion pause stale queued dispatch; explicit resume re-resolves settings. The actual smoke command now uses the same model-selection resolver.

ACP uses exact captured original bytes for supported images at or below20MiB when the actual agent reports image capability, with ordered captured-resource fallback under the64MiB aggregate frame budget.
ACP asynchronous preparation and chunked process writing retain captured leases until Qt drains sent frames; revocation, partial cancellation and timeout terminate the owned transport safely.

liveValidation.scope: Actual custom DeepSeek model read/Markdown, OpenCode image recognition, and managed Claude read tool. Native transcript captures; no new full-window interaction claim.

limits: 701 scope rows and17331 indexed source function bodies are preserved; full semantic, line-by-line, pixel and identical reasoning parity remain unestablished.
Custom options implement a documented protocol subset. Unsupported fields fail explicitly rather than source SDK silent stripping; no arbitrary request-body override.
Custom context-derived attachment/read budgets remain a separate gap. Audio/video/file input and non-text output are not implemented by this slice.
Custom configuration version2 prevents known old version1 readers from silently overwriting newer definitions; ordinary configurations remain version1-compatible.
Native custom-model controls remain list-based with plain JSON advanced editors; source card-inline placement, platform scrollbar and checkbox appearance differ.
Original-image transport applies only to ACP/OpenCode. HTTP/Codex/Claude retain their documented existing policies. Unsupported or oversized images remain captured resource links.
64MiB aggregate ACP limit and bounded write queue are explicit native limits. Cancellation cannot retract bytes already delivered to the pipe or undo external effects.
Synthetic protocol and ownership checks do not prove all remote services or determinism of model behavior. Paid third-party inference requires separately reported live evidence.
Settings presentation, workspace-tree behavior, account/usage paths and other scoped source-ledger gaps remain.
